snippet.title: ♡The Cinderella Contract♡ Promotion Movie with voice attached!
snippet.description:
The special movie of "The Cinderella Contract" has now been released with VOICE ATTACHED!

The princes are moving and even speaking in the movie!
Young and popular Japanese voice actors performed the princes.

■Detail of voice actors■
Dictatorial Prince, Claude - played by Takuya Eguchi.
Black-hearted Prince, Yuri - played by Soma Saito.
Clumsy Prince, Cyril - played by Daiki Yamashita
Chic, Elite Assemblyman? Asena - played by Tomoaki Maeno

■About the Game■
It is basically free to play!
Now, you can get a mini-scenario with voice attached as a bonus item from Japanese version!
Go and download it for free and enjoy the scenarios with voice!

【Story】
You, an ordinary office worker who is good at foreign language, has been invited to attend to a party as a partner of your company's major account.
The party was such a gorgeous one that all of the celebrities around the world are all attending!
You accidentally met the hot and handsome princes there?!
All of the princes were surrounding around you and approaching you!
While you were getting confused, they escorted you a bit forcibly, but tenderly.

The next day after you had such dreamlike night,
you found yourself in trouble in the airport!?
The one who helped you was the prince from last night...!
He forcibly asked you to sign the marriage contract with him instead of repaying his kindness.

So, your newly marriged life as the princess will be started here!!
Anyway, how will this "fake" marriage be ended...?
You might be able to find the true love there...!!

============================

▼Go and download the Cinderella Contract!▼

♥English version (No voice for now)♥
Android→https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.a1a128&hl=ja
iPhone→https://itunes.apple.com/jp/app/cinderella-contract-free-dating/id820916688?mt=8

♥Japanese version (With voice)♥
Android→https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.a1a111&hl=ja
iPhone→https://itunes.apple.com/jp/app/wang-zisamatoikenai-qi-yue/id765385479?mt=8
